From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP marketplace listing & account cartography — AcmeCloud

Team —

Quick sync request: AcmeCloud (Sara) is ready to move toward a GCP marketplace listing and GCP co-sell alignment. Rather than a high-level pipeline sweep, I want to map accounts and listing dependencies so we can identify blockers (procurement, entitlement, listing images, SKUs).

Attached: draft requirements workbook (GCP_listing_requirements_v2.xlsx) and our latest snapshot of Acme opportunities (Acme_opps_snapshot.pdf).

Please confirm the following before Friday:
- Vanessa: confirm GCP partner manager contact and expected co-sell timeline with GCP PMs
- Karthik: review marketplace listing checklist — are there any product/QA items that will add >3 weeks?
- Marcus: can your team validate the billing SKU mapping in the workbook?

Sara, would you be available for a 30-minute account cartography and opportunity scrub on Friday 12:00–12:30 PT? If not, propose alternatives.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
kkim@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: GCP_listing_requirements_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Acme_opps_snapshot.pdf (pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP marketplace listing & account cartography — AcmeCloud

Kimberly —

Thanks, reviewing now. I spoke with my GCP partner manager (PM name withheld for thread) yesterday; high-level notes:
- GCP co-sell intake requires a finalized listing package and a joint GTM statement. They typically need 2–3 weeks to slot internal review after we submit the listing artifacts.
- Co-sell certification / joint-marketing approval often adds another 1–2 weeks.

Action items from me: I will reach out to the PM to request a tentative intake window and add their intake checklist to the Drive link. Also scheduling the Friday 12:00 PT slot — I can make that.

Question for Marcus: for billing SKUs, do we need to create a separate SKU for dedicated vs hosted products, or can we map to a single SKU with tiered usage? That impacts the listing fields in the workbook.

Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Manager, GCP Channels
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: GCP marketplace listing & account cartography — AcmeCloud

All —

Thanks for the workbook, Kimberly. Quick answers:
- We should create distinct SKUs for Dedicated vs Hosted to keep committed billing separate; mapping to a single SKU with tiers will complicate procurement for Acme (they want line-item clarity).
- I reviewed the "billing_mapping" tab and left comments on expected unit names and descriptions.

I also ran a quick export of the Acme opps and added a short PDF (Acme_opps_snapshot.pdf) that highlights renewal dates and purchase channels. Two opportunities (ACME-ENG-47, ACME-PLAT-52) look most likely to convert in next 90 days; we should prioritize those for marketplace-ready artifacts.

I can join the Friday 12:00 PT call.

Marcus Lin
Senior Revenue Ops Analyst
Redwood Inference

Hi Kimberly / Vanessa / Marcus —

Thanks for the materials and the clear asks. Friday 12:00 PT works for me. A couple quick notes from Acme's side: procurement will want line-item SKUs (so Marcus' suggestion to separate SKUs is good) and our legal team has one request around a data residency note for the listing (EU workloads routed to EU regions).

Also: is there a preferred format for the listing images and screenshots? Our UX lead can prepare assets if you send requirements. Finally, can you send a DocuSign link for the MSA addendum we discussed in the last call? Procurement asked for that before marketplace listing can be approved.

Sara Patel

AcmeCloud

Folks —

Good call today. Notes/next steps from engineering/product perspective: 
1) Listing artifacts: send final product description + three screenshots (1200x675 PNG) and an architecture diagram (PDF) to the Drive link. UX guidance: avoid customer-identifying screenshots; use anonymized sample data.
2) QA: no blocking product/QA items; we'll schedule a light integration smoke test with Acme the week of June 7. Expect 2–3 business days for the smoke test and sign-off.
3) DocuSign: I attached a draft MSA addendum to the Drive link and set a placeholder DocuSign request (link below). Procurement can sign once the MSA fields are finalized.

DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/ACME-MSA-2027
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cAcmeListingDraft

I'll take point on the smoke test schedule (Marcus, please share the two opp IDs with the engineering test lead).

Karthik Iyer
